prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: HeyGen is the best overall AI video ad maker
Creatify is better if your main goal is high-volume UGC-style ads
answer_verbatim:
There is **no single best** AI video ad maker for every use case; the right choice depends on whether you want **UGC-style performance ads, avatar-led ads, ecommerce product ads, or multilingual campaigns**.[2][9][11]

If you want the **best overall** pick based on the sources provided, **HeyGen** is the strongest general recommendation for ads because it is repeatedly ranked first for its avatar quality, multilingual reach, and ability to handle multiple ad formats without needing another tool.[1][15] If your focus is specifically **UGC-style performance ads and ecommerce**, **Creatify** is the most common specialist recommendation.[2][11] If you want an **all-in-one short-form ad editor**, **Revid.ai** is presented as best for most short-form paid social workflows.[16]

Quick guide:

| Use case | Best pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Best overall for most ads | **HeyGen** | Strong avatar realism, 175+ languages, broad ad-format support[1][15] |
| UGC-style performance ads | **Creatify** | Frequently ranked best for realistic UGC-style ads and ecommerce workflows[2][11] |
| Short-form paid social editing | **Revid.ai** | Best mix of ad generation, captions, hooks, automation, and publishing[16] |
| Budget / simple ad creation | **AdCreate** | Positioned as broad-featured and affordable[7] |
| Performance-marketing all-in-one | **AdStellar AI** | Emphasizes creative generation plus campaign launch and tracking[8][13] |

If you want one practical answer: **HeyGen is the best overall AI video ad maker**, but **Creatify is better if your main goal is high-volume UGC-style ads**.[1][2][11]
